Evidence & scope

Creator-maintained documentation received separate bounded AI source-content review of identity, construction, human/model roles, formats, access/rights statements and limitations. New human labels or generated rationales/traces are distinguished from inherited inputs. Release configurations, mirrors, source seeds and model names do not multiply family coverage.
